text:
sara-ng: FYI rolled the async-slab allocator + non-blocking KV prefetch to canary this morning. initial numbers look promising.
ben-jiang: awesome — quick summary? p50/p95/p99?
sara-ng: p50 unchanged, p95 -7%, p99 -18% on steady-state traffic for helix models. cost per token down ~12% in the canary pool.
maria-ops: any regressions on tail or error rates?
sara-ng: no error uptick. tail improved for short-seq workloads; longer sequences identical. we saw one spike during a background GC but mitigated by a small tweak.
jordan-rt: can you paste the canary query that produced the numbers? want to reproduce locally.
sara-ng: sure — here's the bench command we used:```bash
./bench_runner --model helix-small --qps 400 --seq-dist short,long --dur 30m --kv-prefetch async-slab --alloc-mode per-gpu
```
sara-ng: and summary stats (canary vs baseline):
- baseline p99: 198ms -> canary p99: 162ms
- baseline cost/token: $0.00041 -> canary: $0.00036
- throughput at 95th: +6%
ryan-ml: nice. did you change batching behavior or is this allocator-only?
sara-ng: allocator + making prefetch non-blocking so it doesn't stall microbatch packing. tiny tweak to coalescer to prefer ready-ready pairs.
ben-jiang: any rollout plan? full prod flip or staged by model family?
sara-ng: plan is staged by capacity group: canary pool -> 25% groups for 2h -> 50% groups for 4h -> full. health checks: p99, error-rate, memory OOMs, and kv-hit ratio. rollback on any p99 regression >5% vs baseline for 10m window.
maria-ops: add a check for increased GPU mem pressure in console dashboards. I'll add alert: gpu_mem.used > baseline+200MB for 5m.
jordan-rt: did you run a stress test for bursty ingest? microburst behavior is sensitive.
sara-ng: yes ran 1h burst tests at 10x qps — p99 held but p50 increased during the burst as coalescer warmed; acceptable for our SLO.
ryan-ml: any model-specific caveats? any older quantized variants affected?
sara-ng: quantized int8 kernels unaffected; change is at runtime allocator/prefetch layer before kernels. verified on int8 and fp16.
ben-jiang: thumbs up from me. can we get a short PR description and a release note for console?
sara-ng: already on it, PR #3982 — description: "async-slab allocator + non-blocking kv prefetch: p99 latency and cost improvements for short-sequence workloads." release note draft: "Reduced p99 latency by up to 18% and lowered per-token cost via allocator & prefetch optimizations. Gradual rollout with automatic rollback on p99 regressions."
maria-ops: tagging @oncall for the rollout window?
sara-ng: deploying at 23:30 UTC tonight. tagging deploy-bot to run canary.
deploy-bot: Canary deployment started for group: helix-canary. 25% -> checks in progress.
ben-jiang: monitoring graphs look clean so far. kv-hit ratio stable.
jordan-rt: if we see any weirdness, flip to 0% and ping infra-ops channel.
sara-ng: noted. post-rollout followup: I'll publish a short bench writeup with config knobs and how to reproduce.
ryan-ml: great work team :tada:
ben-jiang: :thumbsup:
